title: Final project: one change, tested and measured with confidence
summary: Your capstone, on your own complete NAVERA Lite: choose ONE meaningful change (a judge rule, a fault detector, a sensor model, a retrained network…), pre-register how it will be judged, pin the problem with a test that fails first, fly a headless campaign before and after on committed code, and decide with a paired bootstrap interval — accept, reject or inconclusive — in an honest report.
